title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
author: Sicong Leng, Yunze Man, Zhiqi Li, Jing Wang et al.
description: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments. Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training. Timestamped captions are needed for filtering and balancing pretraining data. We present Flora, an…
summary: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments.
takeaways: On internal benchmarks it is competitive with GPT-6 Astra while beating other frontier models.
The model is substantially cheaper than API-based alternatives, roughly 125 times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra.
Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training.
